news.title: Recruitment Notice - 2025-26
news.subtitle: Announcement
news.content: AIC-IIITKottayam has published its recruitment notice for 2025-26. See the Careers page for open positions: /careers

news.title: Call for Non-Stipendiary Internship (2025-26 - Dec/May/June/July)
news.subtitle: Announcement
news.content: If interested, send your CV with the title "Non-Stipendary Internship-FY-25-26 (Summer)" to shajulin@iiitkottayam.ac.in and incubate@iiitkottayam.ac.in. Deadline: 25.12.2025.

news.title: Walk-In-Interview: CEO Position
news.subtitle: Careers
news.content: Walk-in interview for the CEO position. The date of the interview will be intimated via email. Position details: /pdfs/CEO-Position.pdf

news.title: Non-Stipendiary Internships (1 to 6 months)
news.subtitle: Careers
news.content: Non-stipendiary internships for a period of 1 month to 6 months are invited. Interested engineering students are requested to submit their resumes to incubate@iiitkottayam.ac.in and communitymanager-aic@iiitkottayam.ac.in along with a permission letter from their HoD/Principal.

news.title: IEE-Hacks'22: IoT Cloud Analytics and Entrepreneurship Hackathon (An Indo-German Hackathon)
news.subtitle: Event
news.content: Indo-European Entrepreneurship Hackathon 2022 on IoT Cloud Analytics and Entrepreneurship, organised by IIIT Kottayam, AIC-IIITKottayam Foundation and MSME-BI-IIITKottayam jointly with Informatics-I10, Technical University Munich, Germany. Domains: IoT, Cloud, Blockchain, Healthcare, AI, Logistics, Mobility and Forensics. Event held on 23 August 2022; winner: Mr. Shino Lukose, Luka Healthcare Pvt. Ltd. Brochure: /pdfs/hacks2022.pdf

news.title: Call for Nodal Centres Announced
news.subtitle: Announcement
news.content: AIC-IIITKottayam invites institutions to become Nodal Centres. Last date to apply: 15.3.2022. Details: /pdfs/NodalCentre-Call-1.3.2022.pdf

news.title: AIC-IIITKottayam Selected for the Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
news.subtitle: Achievement
news.content: AIC-IIITKottayam got selected for the SeedFund scheme of StartupIndia. The entrepreneurs/startups of AIC can receive seed funding via our centre for their businesses.

news.title: Inviting Quotations: CNC Laser Cutting Machine
news.subtitle: Tender
news.content: Quotations are invited for the purchase of a CNC laser cutting machine. Details: /pdfs/AIC-IIITK-Purchase-2021-22-001.pdf

news.title: Serve Nation as an Entrepreneur: Defence India Startup Challenge 5 Outreach Webinar
news.subtitle: Event
news.content: As an outreach hosting organisation for the Defence Innovation Organisation (DIO), AIC IIIT Kottayam organised an outreach webinar on 23 September 2021 (14:30-18:30) to bring together startups, MSMEs and individual innovators to submit proposals to the 35 DISC 5 challenges. Programme: introduction of iDEX by PD/DIO, graduation ceremony, training on 'Design Thinking and Business Model', and proposal submission instructions.

news.title: Story Telling Competition: Impact of Covid-19 in Our Society
news.subtitle: Event
news.content: A story telling competition for children aged 8 to 12 across India on 'Impact of Covid-19 in Our Society'. Videos of up to 5 minutes were accepted from 09 August to 13 September 2021; results were published on 17 September 2021.

news.title: Workshop on IoT Research and Effective Writing of Articles
news.subtitle: Workshop
news.content: An online workshop by Dr. Shajulin Benedict (Director/PI, AIC-IIITKottayam) on 28 July 2021 for faculty (CSE, ECE, IT, EEE), PhD students and working professionals, covering the basics of IoT, research on IoT papers and effective writing of articles.

news.title: FridayStars: A Bridge Between Students and Entrepreneurs
news.subtitle: Programme
news.content: FridayStars seeds entrepreneurship culture among students, bringing together startups, mentors, academicians and industry. The first phase is a one-month foundation course covering how to start up, the hurdles involved, how to overcome them, and how AIC can help.

news.title: IoTCloud'21: ACM/CSI/IEEECS Research & Industry Symposium on IoT Cloud for Societal Applications
news.subtitle: Symposium
news.content: A research and industry symposium held on 3 May 2021 in honour of Shri. F.C. Kohli, Father of the Indian Software Industry, organised by ACM, CSI & IEEE CS Chennai with the IEEE SB and ACM SC of IIIT Kottayam. Topics included IoT Cloud, IIoT, green technologies, smart cities, smart mobility, IoT analytics, federated learning and blockchain. Awardees: /pdfs/awardees.pdf
